posts.description: Peter Lobner, 3 October 2026 S-Class submarines were the first class of U.S.-designed subs procured in significant numbers. Fifty-one were commissioned by the Navy between 1920 – 1925. These subs had an overall length of 219’, a maximum beam of 20.6 ’, and displaced 854 tons surfaced / 1,062 tons submerged.
